fields.label: Platform
fields.description: Store the purchase came from (android). Blank for manual grants.

fields.label: Purchase Token
fields.description: Play purchase token this entitlement rests on. Required to revalidate or revoke it — without it a refunded purchase can never be clawed back.

fields.label: Last Verified At
fields.description: Last successful re-check against the Play Developer API.

fields.label: Revoked At
fields.description: Set when Play reported the purchase refunded, revoked or expired.
